query:
SELECT mac.machine_id AS "machine_id!",
               mac.hostname   AS "hostname!",
               mac.last_seen  AS "last_seen!",
               lm.last_message_at
        FROM machines mac
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT MAX(m.created_at) AS last_message_at
            FROM messages m
            WHERE m.machine_id = mac.machine_id
        ) lm ON true
        ORDER BY mac.machine_id
